evidence_span: We divided the platysma, raised superior and inferior flaps, reflected the right strap muscle off the right thyroid lobe.  We separated the superior pole from the cricothyroid muscle and sequentially took down the superior pole vessels with LigaSure Exact.  We rotated the right thyroid lobe anteriorly and identified her right recurrent laryngeal nerve nicely.  We then inferiorly divided the pole vessels, saving the inferior parathyroid.  We traced the right recurrent laryngeal nerve up to the ligament of Berry and divided the thyroid at the ligament of Berry.  The integrity of the right recurrent laryngeal nerve was intact without any change in stimulation with a nice proximal stim.  We then bovied the remainder off the trachea and divided the right thyroid lobe at the isthmus, sent it for frozen section by placing a stitch in superior pole.  It was a benign hyperplastic nodule on frozen, and we then proceeded to irrigate the right neck copiously.
